snippet: In the sidebar, select New Work Order (1). The form opens at the customer step.

title: Enter the customer's name
snippet: Enter the customer's full name (1). Only the name and the mobile number are mandatory. Other fields carry an asterisk but are not enforced.

snippet: A received garment is held in Parking until its work is planned. Select Schedule (1) to pass it to the scheduler.

title: Open the order in Handover mode
snippet: Open the order from the cashier. Where a balance is outstanding the page opens in Payment mode. Select Handover (1).

title: Record the collection
snippet: Select each garment being handed over (1), then select Collect (2). Only garments the customer is physically taking should be selected.

title: Order completion
snippet: The selected garments are recorded as completed. When every garment on the order has reached a terminal state, the order itself is closed.
